title: Petition of the Massachusetts Highway Department (formerly, Massachusetts Department of Public Works) requesting that the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to G.L. c. 159, § 59 and G.L. c. 160, §§ 102 and 104, consent in writing to the construction or alteration of three highway- rail grade crossings and the relocation of two sections of track at track locations owned by Consolidated Rail Corporation and the Massachusetts Port Authority in connection with the Construction of the Central Artery Tunnel Project's South Boston Haul Road.
